# Pruebas con Forwarding activado (Sin NOPs)
00100000000010000000000000001010 # addi $t0, $zero, 10
00100000000010010000000000000101 # addi $t1, $zero, 5
00000001000010010101000000100000 # add  $t2, $t0, $t1 ($t2 = 15)
00000001000010010101100000100010 # sub  $t3, $t0, $t1 ($t3 = 5)
00000001000010010110000000100100 # and  $t4, $t0, $t1 ($t4 = 0)
00000001000010010110100000100101 # or   $t5, $t0, $t1 ($t5 = 15)
00000001000010010111000000100110 # xor  $t6, $t0, $t1 ($t6 = 15)
10101100000010100000000000000100 # sw   $t2, 4($zero) (Guarda 15 en Mem[4])
10001100000011110000000000000100 # lw   $t7, 4($zero) (Lee 15 en $t7)
